name: Ganged Raycasting
definition: A technique where multiple rays are traced together as a group (gang) to optimize computation, specifically by tracing a rectangular pyramid region of the display plane rather than individual rays, splitting the group only when the rays diverge into non-continuous voxel sets.
summary: Ganged Raycasting is a volume rendering optimization that groups horizontally aligned rays into rectangular pyramids to reduce per-ray overhead by processing them as a single unit until they diverge.
